## IRedisCacheOptions.conn property

An existing Redis client to reuse — a running service's queue writer, for example — instead of opening a new connection.

**Signature:**

```typescript
conn?: IRedisClient;
```

## Remarks

Honoured only while no shared connection exists yet.
